  SELECT month, gross_revenue, gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_diff
  FROM monthly
)

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id, created_at FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
orders AS (
  SELECT c.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi
    ON oi.user_id = c.id
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= c.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < c.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY c.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS share
FROM orders

SELECT u.traffic_source, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id),0))::numeric,2) AS revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at))/3600.0) AS median_hours FROM public.order_items WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue_2024
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT p1.user_id,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p2.order_date - p1.order_date))/86400.0 AS days_diff
  FROM ranked p1
  JOIN ranked p2 ON p1.user_id = p2.user_id AND p1.rn = 1 AND p2.rn = 2
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM pairs

             AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
             AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
             AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'

           SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi

             AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
             AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'

FROM public.users u
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 4 DESC

WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend) AS p90
FROM per_user

WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT uo.user_id, uo.order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uo.user_id ORDER BY uo.order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders uo
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = uo.user_id
  WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
first_second AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN order_time END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order))/86400.0) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH order_agg AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_created_at,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
         BOOL_OR(status <> 'Cancelled') AS is_noncancelled
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_created_at) AS rn
  FROM order_agg
  WHERE is_noncancelled
),
medians AS (
  SELECT
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_median,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FILTER (WHERE rn > 1) AS repeat_median
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT first_median, repeat_median, first_median - repeat_median AS diff FROM medians

ranked AS (

pairs AS (

)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS p95_days
FROM pairs
